events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating the comedic genius of John Cleese, who turns 87 today! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his work remains iconic.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their groundbreaking 'White Album'. Which track from the double LP is still on your playlist?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Remembering Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. A true legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Masterpiece
angles.copy: A classic turns 61! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day, marking a pivotal shift in their sound.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Remembering musician, songwriter, and activist John Lennon, who passed away on this day in 1980 at the age of 40. He would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today, born in 1947.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: The legendary David Bowie would have turned 80 today. Forever missed, never forgotten. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today, born in 1935.

angles.name: Long Live the King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King lives on!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and founder Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today, born in 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today, born in 1945.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the unmistakable voice of Rod Stewart! A true rock and roll icon.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today, born in 1961.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th to the one and only Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house down after all these years.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today, born in 1956.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the incredible Paul Young! Still Wherever I Lay My Hat, that's his home.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Dolly Parton, who would have celebrated her 81st birthday today, born in 1946.

angles.name: Jolene, Jolene, Jolene
angles.copy: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we pay tribute to the one and only Dolly Parton. Her music and spirit shine on.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today, born in 1971.

angles.name: Take That's Leading Man
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the incredible Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, a true songwriting talent.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today, born in 1950.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 77th birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car and celebrate!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held on this day in 1986, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Honouring Legends
angles.copy: On this day in 1986, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction. Who would be in your dream Hall of Fame class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today, born in 1972.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still shining bright after all these years with Take That.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: One Last Performance
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles played their iconic final live performance on a London rooftop. A moment etched in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today, born in 1951.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo stardom, his influence is undeniable.
